ns2:course.label: Group Representation Theory
ns2:course.description: Representation of groups by linear transformations, group algebras, character theory, and modular representations. Prerequisite: MATH 501 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS: Financial Engineering, MENG:Mechanical Enginerng-UIUC, MENG:Elec & Computer Eng-UIUC, or MENG:Engineering:Comp Eng-UIUC.
